Thou shalt first set foot upon Narita Airport

Day One Arrival in the fair city of Tokyo
Thou shalt first set foot upon Narita Airport
Then take the train to thy lodging in Shinjuku
After thou hast rested visit the Meiji Shrine
Walk thou the quiet forest paths
Then wander unto Harajuku where fashion doth bloom
In the eve thou mayest view the Shibuya crossing
Its lights like stars upon the earth

Day Two Tales of old Edo
Morning thou shalt go to the Imperial Palace Gardens
Stroll thou the moats and stone walls
Afterward visit the Asakusa district
Enter thou the Senso ji Temple
Offer thou a coin and pray for safe travel
Then walk thou Nakamise market where snacks doth tempt
Evening thou mayest cruise the Sumida River
Watch thou the city lights dance upon the water

Day Three Journey to Kyoto
Board thou the Shinkansen at Tokyo Station
Speed thou past Mount Fuji in glorious sight
Arrive thou in Kyoto by noon
Check thou into a ryokan near Gion
After thou hast refreshed walk thou the Philosopher's Path
See thou the cherry blossoms if season doth allow
Visit thou the Silver Pavilion Ginkaku ji
Evening thou mayest spy geisha hurrying to their engagements

Day Four Temples and Gardens
Morning thou shalt enter the Fushimi Inari shrine
Pass thou through countless vermilion torii gates
Climb thou the mountain behind the shrine
Afterward descend thou to the Nishiki market
Taste thou takoyaki and matcha sweets
Afternoon thou shalt explore the Kinkaku ji Golden Pavilion
Reflect thou upon the pond that mirrors its glory
Evening thou shalt attend a tea ceremony in a machiya house

Day Five Nara and return
Take thou a train to Nara in the morning
Meet thou the friendly deer in Nara Park
Visit thou the Todai ji Temple housing the great Buddha
After thou hast fed the deer return thou to Kyoto
Spend thou thy last hours shopping for souvenirs in Nishiki
Board thou the Shinkansen back to Tokyo
Arrive thou at thy hotel ere night doth fall
Rest thou for thy flight home
